issues.detail: The request leaves open whether a caller can apply date filters without a keyword query (existing AC-003 rejects empty queries) and how invalid or inverted date ranges behave. A Scoper could treat one of these as blocking, persist BlockedOn, and stop before restructuring docs/product/search.md. That would make all four assertions fail. CONTEXT.md's 'Invalid input is reported by throwing SearchError' and the explicit inclusive wording make proceeding with non-blocking assumptions the more likely path.
issues.fix: Acceptable. If runs show Scoper blocking on this, tighten Active Work.Request (for example, 'date filters narrow the keyword results')..

issues.detail: Check 2 rejects any list item above `## Previous Cycles` that begins with AC-001..AC-004, even when it is not a definition, such as '- `AC-001`–`AC-003` behavior is preserved' under Constraints. Check 1 matches the heading case-sensitively. Both edge cases are unlikely, because the protocol and template name the exact heading and a current list item that starts with an old ID would be odd.
All commits, including the earlier cycle's (id timestamp 2026-09-15), share the date 2026-09-27T10:30Z. This is cosmetic and does not affect behavior or checks.
